name: America
overview: Scripture emphasizes that a nation's blessing and exaltation come from righteousness and having God as its foundation, as seen in Psalms 33:12 and Proverbs 14:34. True peace and security are found not in worldly abundance or power but in the peace Christ gives, which surpasses what the world offers (Luke 12:15; John 14:27). Jesus reminds us that His kingdom is not of this world, indicating that ultimate allegiance must be to His eternal reign rather than earthly nations (John 18:36). Believers are called to hold fast to God's word and faith in Christ, which is essential for a nation's spiritual health (John 5:38).
